name: bokio-mcp

tools.name: bokio_company_info
tools.description: Get the Bokio company's own details, such as its name and organisation number. Use it to confirm which company the token and companyId point at.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_list_fiscal_years
tools.description: List the company's fiscal years with their ids and start and end dates. The ids feed bokio_download_sie and the fiscalYearId of bokio_account_balances.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_get_fiscal_year
tools.description: Get one fiscal year by id, with its start and end dates. bokio_list_fiscal_years returns all of them in one call.

fiscalYearId.description: Id from bokio_list_fiscal_years; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_chart_of_accounts
tools.description: List the company's BAS chart of accounts: account numbers with names. Use it to find the account number the ledger and balance tools take; bokio_get_account reads a single account.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_account
tools.description: Get one account from the BAS chart of accounts by number. For its balance or postings use bokio_account_balances or bokio_account_ledger.

account.description: BAS account number, such as 1930; bokio_chart_of_accounts lists them.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_download_sie
tools.description: Download the raw SIE 4 export of one fiscal year to savePath, or return its first 4,000 characters as text when savePath is omitted. For balances, ledgers, VAT or profit and loss use the computed tools, which read this export themselves and do the arithmetic.

fiscalYearId.description: Id from bokio_list_fiscal_years; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

savePath.description: File path inside BOKIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else the working directory; an existing file is never overwritten, so pick a new name.

tools.name: bokio_account_balances
tools.description: Compute the opening balance, movement and balance per account at a date from the SIE export. Use it for what is on an account at a date; bokio_account_ledger shows the individual lines. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

date.description: Balance date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the fiscal year's last day when fiscalYearId is given, else today.

fiscalYearId.description: Id from bokio_list_fiscal_years; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

tools.name: bokio_account_ledger
tools.description: List the postings on one account between two dates with a running balance, ordered by date, series and number, computed from the SIE export. Annulled verifications are kept and flagged cancelled; bokio_list_journal_entries lists whole verifications instead. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

account.description: BAS account number, such as 1930; bokio_chart_of_accounts lists them.

tools.name: bokio_find_duplicates
tools.description: Find possible double bookings in the SIE export: lines with the same account and amount from different verifications within windowDays of each other. Annulled verifications are skipped; to check against a bank statement use bokio_reconcile_bank. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

account.description: Only this BAS account; omit for all accounts.

windowDays.description: Max days between the two bookings; default 7.

tools.name: bokio_reconcile_bank
tools.description: Match bank statement rows against one ledger account by exact amount within toleranceDays, reading the SIE export itself; rows in date order each take the earliest unmatched ledger line within toleranceDays, each ledger line once. Returns matched pairs, unmatched rows on both sides, suspected duplicate ledger lines and totals, where difference = ledger minus bank. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

toleranceDays.description: Max days between a bank row and its ledger line; default 3.

rows.description: Bank statement rows; amounts in kronor with at most two decimals, outflow negative.

tools.name: bokio_vat_summary
tools.description: Sum the VAT accounts (2610-2659) and sales accounts (3000-3999) for a period, with outputVat (negated 2610-2639), inputVat (2640-2649) and netVat = output minus input, positive when VAT is to pay. These are account totals and do not map to tax-return boxes. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Sum the result accounts (BAS classes 3-8) for a period, grouped by class or by account, with result = negated total so that profit is positive. For balance-sheet accounts use bokio_account_balances. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

groupBy.description: Group by BAS class (3-8) or by account; default class.

tools.name: bokio_open_items
tools.description: List unpaid items on a ledger account at asOf, matching each payment to the earliest unpaid posting of the same amount (FIFO, exact öre). Returns open items with their age in days, payments that matched nothing, the balance, and the oldest loaded year's opening balance as one unitemised amount. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

account.description: Ledger account; default 1510 (receivables), 2440 for supplier debt.

asOf.description: Date to evaluate at (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to today.

lookbackYears.description: Calendar years before the year of asOf to load, so older unpaid items are itemised; default 1.

tools.name: bokio_list_journal_entries
tools.description: List journal entries (verifikationer) with paging, optionally between from and to or narrowed by a raw query filter. For the postings on one account use bokio_account_ledger.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_journal_entry
tools.description: Get one journal entry (verifikation) by id, as Bokio returns it. To find entries by date use bokio_list_journal_entries.

journalEntryId.description: Id from bokio_list_journal_entries; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices with paging and a raw query filter. Revenue booked as journal entries is not listed here; use bokio_account_ledger or bokio_open_items for that.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one customer invoice by id, as Bokio returns it. Use bokio_download_invoice for the PDF and bokio_list_invoice_payments for its payments.

invoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_download_invoice
tools.description: Download a published invoice as a PDF file to savePath. Returns the written path and byte count; bokio_get_invoice returns the invoice data instead.

invoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

savePath.description: File path inside BOKIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else the working directory; an existing file is never overwritten, so pick a new name.

tools.name: bokio_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments registered on one invoice, with paging. Fees and currency differences are listed by bokio_list_invoice_settlements.

invoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_list_invoice_settlements
tools.description: List the settlements on one invoice: currency differences, bank fees and payment-service fees. Payments are listed by bokio_list_invoice_payments.

invoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes (kreditfakturor) with paging and a raw query filter. Customer invoices are listed by bokio_list_invoices.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_credit_note
tools.description: Get one credit note by id, as Bokio returns it. Use bokio_download_credit_note for the PDF.

creditNoteId.description: Id from bokio_list_credit_notes; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_download_credit_note
tools.description: Download a published credit note as a PDF file to savePath. Returns the written path and byte count.

creditNoteId.description: Id from bokio_list_credit_notes; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

savePath.description: File path inside BOKIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else the working directory; an existing file is never overwritten, so pick a new name.

tools.name: bokio_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (leverantörer) with paging and a raw query filter. Their invoices are listed by bokio_list_supplier_invoices.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id, as Bokio returns it. Their invoices are listed by bokio_list_supplier_invoices.

supplierId.description: Id from bokio_list_suppliers; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

tools.name: bokio_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices (leverantörsfakturor) with paging and a raw query filter. For unpaid supplier debt by age use bokio_open_items on account 2440.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_supplier_invoice
tools.description: Get one supplier invoice by id, as Bokio returns it. An attached file downloads with bokio_download_upload.

supplierInvoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_supplier_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_bank_payment
tools.description: Get one bank payment by id. Bokio returns only payments created by this integration, and creating them is deliberately not exposed.

bankPaymentId.description: Id from bokio_list_bank_payments; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

customerId.description: Id from bokio_list_customers; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

tools.name: bokio_get_item
tools.description: Get one item (artikel) by id, as Bokio returns it.

itemId.description: Id from bokio_list_items; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

tools.name: bokio_download_upload

uploadId.description: Id from bokio_list_uploads; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

tools.name: bokio_raw_get
tools.description: Send a GET to any Bokio API path that no other tool covers; {companyId} in the path is replaced with the company id. Returns the response body.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

instructions:
Bokio accounting API for one company.

Writes: tools that change data exist only when the server runs with BOKIO_ALLOW_WRITES=1. If a write tool is missing, writes are off; say so and never report a booking, invoice or payment as done unless the call succeeded. Every write changes the live books, so confirm it with the user first. Tools marked destructive (publish, record, reverse, delete, bokio_update_supplier_invoice) cannot be undone.

Numbers: for balances, ledgers, VAT, profit and loss, open items, double bookings and bank reconciliation use the computed tools that read the SIE export instead of summing journal entries yourself; they compute in whole öre. Amounts are in ledger sign, debit positive, credit negative, so liabilities, equity and revenue show negative. A verification and its "Annullering av ..." reversal cancel out.

Cost: each computed call lists the fiscal years, then downloads one SIE export per fiscal year it touches. Bokio allows 5,000 requests per company per month and 200 per minute, so ask for the date range you need and reuse results.

Gaps: revenue booked as journal entries does not appear in bokio_list_invoices; use bokio_account_ledger or bokio_open_items. bokio_raw_get reads any other Bokio path.
